newsitem.title: USA: Woman charged in Kentucky nursing home slayings.
newsitem.headline: Woman charged in Kentucky nursing home slayings.

text.p: A 23-year-old woman was charged with two counts of murder Wednesday for allegedly gunning down two supervisors at a nursing home from which she was fired.
Jefferson County Police said Kimberly Harris of Elizabethtown, Kentucky, was captured about 30 minutes after the slayings Tuesday night and would be arraigned later in the day.
Investigators said she was outside the Jefferson Place nursing home near Louisville when Deborah Bell, 46, the facility's executive director, and Patty Eitel, 43, its nursing director, left work.

Harris, who had recently been discharged from her job as a nursing assistant at the home, fired several shots, killing both women, police said. She was caught when police stopped her car on Interstate 65 south of Louisville.
